E
ISLAMABAD CAPITAL TERRITORY LOCAL GOVERNMENT
ELECTIONS RULES, 2002
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I,
5th November, 2002]
S.R.O. 778(I)/2002, dated 31-10-2002.--In exercise of the powers conferred by section 41 of the Islamabad
Capital Territory Local Government Elections Ordinance, 2002 (LVII of 2002),
the Federal Government is pleased to make the following rules, namely:--
CHAPTER-I
PRELIMINARY
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) These rules may be called the Islamabad Capital Territory Local
Government Elections Rules, 2002.
(2) These shall come into force at once and
shall apply, notwithstanding anything to the contrary contained in any other
rules on the subject.
2. Definitions.- In these rules,
unless there is anything repugnant in the subject or context,-
(a) "Appellate
Authority" means an appellate authority appointed under these rules;
(b) "ballot
paper" means a ballot .paper set out in Forms X(A),X(B), X(C) or X(D) in
the rules;
(c) "ballot
paper account" means a ballot paper account prepared under these rules;
(d)
"candidate" means a person nominated for election as member;
(e) "contesting
candidate" means a candidate who has been validly nominated for election
as a member of a ward or as a Nazim or a Naib Nazim of a district or union and
has not withdrawn his nomination on or before the withdrawal day;
(f)
"Council" means a Zila Council or Union Council constituted under the
Ordinance;
(g)
"Delimitation Officer" means a person appointed for the delimitation
of a ward of a Union Council and includes an Assistant Delimitation Officer
performing the functions of a delimitation officer;
(h) "Election
Commissioner" means the Chief Election Commissioner of Pakistan;
(i) "electoral
roll" means electoral rolls prepared under section 12 of the Ordinance;
(j) "election
petition" means a petition calling in question an election under these
Ordinance or these rules;
(k) "election
tribunal" means an election tribunal appointed under the Ordinance or
these rules for the trial of an election petition;
(l) "form"
means a form appended to these rules;
(m) "material
irregularity" means non compliance of the provisions of these rules which
materially affect the result of an election;
(n) "minority
community" includes persons belonging to the Christian, Hindu, Sikh,
Buddhist and Parsi communities, a person of the Qadiani Group or the Lahori
Group (who call themselves 'Ahmadis' or by any other name) or a Bahai or any
other person who is a 'non-Muslim' as described in Article 260 of the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of
Pakistan 1973;
(o) "nomination
day" means a day appointed under these rules for the nomination of
candidates;
(p)
"Ordinance" means the Islamabad Capital Territory Local Government
Elections Ordinance, 2002 (LVII of 2002);
(q) "polling
agent" means a polling agent appointed by a candidate under these rules;
(r) "polling
day" means the day on which poll is taken for election of a member;
(s) "Polling
Officer" means a polling officer appointed under these rules;
(t) "polling
station" means a premises where arrangements are made for a poll;
???????????
(u) "Presiding
Officer" means a presiding officer appointed under these rules and
includes an Assistant Presiding Officer exercising powers and performing the
functions of a Presiding Officer;
(v)
"publish" includes exhibition at a prominent place accessible to the
public;
(w) "returned
candidate" means a candidate who has been declared elected as a member of
a Council or a Nazim or a Naib Nazim of a Union or a District;
(x) "Returning
Officer" means a returning officer appointed under these rules and
includes Assistant Returning Officer exercising powers and performing functions
of a Returning Officer;
(y) "Validly
nominated candidate" means a candidate whose nomination has been accepted
under these rules; and
(z) "withdrawal
day" means a day fixed under these rules on of before which candidature may be withdrawn.

CHIEF ELECTION COMMISSIONER
